title: Stomp! Stomp! Elephant
level_description: Consonant blends (st, mp, nd, sp): stomp, jump, stand, spend, 8-12 words per page

character.name: Ella
character.description: Cute small gray baby elephant with big floppy ears, long trunk, stubby legs, tiny tail, big round friendly eyes
